property_summary: The owner can only be changed by the admin; the bug allows any non-admin caller to change the owner.
After setOwner is called by the admin, the owner state variable must be updated to the provided argument; the buggy version instead updates admin, so owner remains unchanged, violating the rule.

After a successful setOwner call by the admin, the owner variable must equal the newly set address; the buggy version leaves owner unchanged, so the stored owner does not match the argument passed to setOwner.
For any caller, setOwner succeeds only if called by admin; the bug lets any caller change owner.

For any call to setOwner, the owner after the call must equal the _owner argument passed. The bug sets owner to msg.sender instead, so the postcondition owner == _owner fails whenever the caller (admin) differs from _owner.
For any admin caller and any new owner address, a successful setOwner call must return true; the buggy version breaks this by always returning false.
After any call to setOwner, the owner variable must equal the _owner argument that was passed, but the buggy version always sets owner to address(0) regardless of the argument.
After a call to setOwner by the admin, the current owner must equal the admin, but the buggy version sets owner to address(0) instead.
After the admin successfully calls setOwner with any non-zero address, the owner should equal that address; the bug breaks this by always setting owner to address(0).
The owner can only be set by the admin; the buggy version allows any caller to change the owner, violating admin-gated access.
